title: International Monetary Transition
question: Which reserve, settlement, invoicing, FX and stablecoin changes constitute diversification, pricing or actual monetary substitution?
bluf: Reserve diversification, regional settlement and trade invoicing remain separate from actual monetary substitution. Bessent's April 2026 IIF scorecard adds the incumbent strategy and a three-way legitimacy contest. The IMF symmetry audit finds candid surveillance of systemic members but operationalized, finance-linked adjustment for borrowers. The July 31 Japan–Korea cases and saved August Japanese confirmation distinguish national intervention and dealer prices from a separate stablecoin quote; the disclosed aggregate does not resolve every trade date, allocation or U.S. funding leg. Korea's observed token price transmission is not net capital flow; Japan's limited production rails are not shown to have supported intervention. The September 1 Asheville G20 Chair's Statement adds agreed work on digital assets and payment modernization, but China expressly objected to four paragraphs and the statement itself is not implementation or monetary substitution. Masu's September 10 BOJ speech supplied an individual hawkish-normalization signal. The September 28 July-meeting minutes and the September 18 decision close the first rate-decision clock: the Board raised the overnight target and complementary deposit rate to 1.25 percent effective September 24. The minutes show bank lending remained strong, major/regional and shinkin outcomes diverged, and no new prudential rule was made; JGB-stock-runoff, bank-level transmission, market-stability and digital-rail clocks remain separate. The Japan Monetary Constitution build uses balance-sheet movement as its empirical spine. Layer 0 finds that the 2021–2026 JGB–HKD link synchronized BOJ-recorded JGB title with HKMA central-bank money without creating a new claim or merging finality; the September 11 retirement is established, while utilization, rationale and successor remain unknown. Layer 1 finds embedded BOJ independence inside a braided Diet–Cabinet–MOF–BOJ–FSA authority structure: the BOJ can operate a JGB auction without buying the debt, execute MOF intervention without deciding it, and settle government funds without authorizing expenditure. Layer 2 finds a multi-book transition: the BOJ's audited fiscal-2025 balance sheet contracted by ¥66.742 trillion; reserve remuneration more than doubled and the Treasury payment fell; sovereign debt and interest expense rose on separate government clocks; and current MOF/FEFSA intervention is material while the latest monthly operation's direction remains undisclosed. Layer 3 finds asymmetric private transmission: bank core margins improved, but shinkin net income fell and regional banks realized ¥1.136 trillion of bond losses; floating borrowers repriced on staged clocks; GPIF absorbed ¥14.753 trillion of domestic bonds while its bond sleeve lost 5.11 percent; and capital, stress tests and delinquency data still show an orderly system. Layer 4 finds private JGB risk-bearing inside public finality: MOF shortened issuance toward investor capacity, recent benchmark auctions remained covered, and repo and JSCC intermediate funding and default risk, while BOJ-NET retains title and yen settlement and the BOJ retains collateral, scarcity-lending and contingent-purchase authority. Layer 5 finds singleness without sameness: cash, BOJ reserves, bank deposits, safeguarded provider balances, trust stablecoins and tokenized deposits share a denomination but not a debtor, ledger, asset or failure path. JPYSC is live but closed-loop and tiny; DCJPY remains an issuing-bank deposit; both BOJ CBDC tracks remain pre-production. The concrete digital-money balance-sheet change is the 2026 capacity to move up to half of a trust-stablecoin reserve from demand deposits into qualifying short sovereign securities or term deposits, adding valuation, liquidity and contribution clocks without giving tokenholders title to the reserve asset. Layer 6 finds many interfaces but few finality rooms: BOJ-NET supplies wholesale yen finality and JGB title; Zengin's large-value RTGS, small-value DNS and More Time clocks can put customer credit ahead of interbank finality; and its collateral and private mutualized loss rules keep liquidity distinct from loss. Zengin-Net's own 2026 diagnosis supports constitutional refactoring under infrastructure strain, but the conditional fiscal-2030 replacement and unresolved settlement asset do not establish crisis or a completed successor. Layer 7 finds mobility without monetary succession: Agorá's real-value tests, Swift's shared commitments, DCJPY, stablecoins, tokenized JGBs and the live Indonesia–Japan QR corridor move coordination and programmable control faster than they move debtor identity, final yen settlement or statutory title. Retail CBDC would create a direct public BOJ claim but remains unauthorized and simulated. The evidence supports constitutional refactoring through adapters, not current monetary replacement or an established legitimacy crisis. Layer 8 finds public continuity and layered loss: BOJ finality and Articles 33/37/38 liquidity sit at the public center, but BOJ credit is not intended to compensate solvency loss; DICJ insurance and resolution, TLAC, JSCC/Zengin waterfalls, fraud restitution and industry contributions allocate cost before legally gated fiscal support. The evidence supports concentrated classification power and bounded legitimacy pressure, while April 2026 capital, funding and stress results argue against a current systemic or legitimacy crisis. The final Japan proof follows six transaction and failure paths and rules for constitutional refactoring without monetary succession: plural risk-bearing inside public finality. It strongly supports concentrated finality and distributed balance-sheet burden, but not current monetary replacement, systemic crisis or an established legitimacy crisis; unequal protection and burden support only a bounded, falsifiable legitimacy-pressure inference. The governed six-lens visual makes the whole constitution, balance-sheet migration, JGB life cycle, payment-finality chain, digital adapters and failure/loss ladder inspectable while preserving the source owners and bounded states. The September 14 UK delta identifies collateral mobility as the near-term centre of the joint FCA–Bank wholesale-tokenisation program and opens a bounded FCA inquiry into eligible physical-gold ownership tokens, while preserving separate title, custody, collateral, settlement, finality, prudential, perimeter and failure clocks. The records support burden migration and constitutional refactoring, but not a present solvency or legitimacy-crisis claim.
evidence_cutoff_note: Broad package remains frozen through August 4. Initiation and Next Phase carry targeted saved Japan legal, bank, pilot and insurance-instrument observations from the August 31 review; currency defense carries the saved August 3 Japanese confirmation and August 28 aggregate disclosure with the reported event-date mismatch unresolved; the Asheville G20 ministerial outcome was refreshed through September 3; targeted BOJ normalization, official-site readings and the completed Japan Monetary Constitution Layers 0–8 and system-wide ruling were refreshed through September 15 01:11 JST. The JGB marginal-buyer and Japan–U.S. insurance returns are separately refreshed through September 15 02:55 JST; they distinguish cash ownership from leveraged price-setting and structural insurance convergence from identical scale or control. The UK Monetary Constitution retains its September 13 layer cutoffs and adds a September 14 primary-source delta for FS26/1 and the FCA tokenised-gold Call for Input. The petrodollar history, transaction, claim and source package is refreshed through September 15 and does not refresh unrelated regional states. A bounded Japan minutes/rate return extends through September 28 at 08:50 JST. A second official-site documentation sweep extends facility terms, BOJ-NET implementation, current-account access, legacy DICJ-route retirement, supervisory requests, bank-risk reviews and statistical/source-version controls through September 28 at 10:16 JST; it does not refresh every Japan layer, bank balance sheet or outcome. Other regional states retain their stated cutoffs.
use_note: Selected jurisdictions and source states through July 31, with targeted saved Japan corrections from the August 31 review, an Asheville G20 outcome refresh through September 3, a BOJ rate/JGB signal refresh through September 14, and a bounded July-minutes/September-rate return through September 28 at 08:50 JST. These exceptions do not refresh every jurisdiction, rail, Japanese bank or prudential rule. Supports diversification, legal-object, policy-transmission and rail comparisons; does not turn a chair's statement, one Policy Board member's speech or an MPM discussion into universal consensus, domestic implementation, a prudential-rule amendment, reserve-currency replacement, net capital flow or production use of every announced digital-money rail. Split 2026-10-03 (Katie): its sixteen sub-studies now have their own entries; this parent stays as the umbrella and holds the shared timelines. Its old Sky & Charts shortcut was removed; research and astrology meet only on dates, in the Mundane Astrology section.

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains both the original public view and a crawler-friendly static HTML reading edition. public_full_text is true.
availability_semantics.public_machine_data: The public site contains the complete positively selected structured dataset. public_full_text is true; reading_url and data_url identify the canonical JSON object.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. public_full_text is false and access_state is private_by_design. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
